moneyCostReport.title: Costs report
moneyCostReport.sub: Every cost row for any period, by day, month or year and by service or module, with the export. Only shows; nothing is paid from here.

note.future: The period ends today: later days have no costs yet.
note.swapped: From was after To, so the two days were turned round.
note.tooLong: One report covers at most {days} days, so the period starts later.
note.byMonth: More than {rows} days are shown month by month.

total.title: Total
total.sub: {from} to {to} · days in the shop's own time zone; a cost line entered for an earlier day counts on that day

buckets.sub: The newest first; the line under each shows what it was spent on

ai.title: AI this month
ai.sub: This store's AI cost rows against the monthly AI cap (the cap covers the whole installation)
ai.noCapHelp: No monthly AI cap is set. The owner sets it in the AI settings; until then nothing is compared.

export.title: Export
export.sub: The same period as a CSV file for the accountant
